business_problem: Marine electronics expert Elcome understands the importance of reliable broadband connectivity to keep its customers safe at sea and keep their businesses operating smoothly. Working with Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program member Onyx Data, Elcome deployed Microsoft Fabric—including the Real-Time Intelligence, real-time hub, and data activator features—along with Copilot to build Welcome, an industry-first, ISP-grade monitoring and management platform that is scalable, flexible, and future-proof.
solution_summary: Marine electronics expert Elcome understands the importance of reliable broadband connectivity to keep its customers safe at sea and keep their businesses operating smoothly. Working with Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program member Onyx Data, Elcome deployed Microsoft Fabric—including the Real-Time Intelligence, real-time hub, and data activator features—along with Copilot to build Welcome, an industry-first, ISP-grade monitoring and management platform that is scalable, flexible, and future-proof. With its Microsoft-powered solution, Elcome has reduced data latency from minutes to seconds, giving customers high-speed connectivity that keeps vessels and crews safe and well-informed in the ever-changing marine environment.

With its Microsoft-powered solution, Elcome has reduced data latency from minutes to seconds, giving customers high-speed connectivity that keeps vessels and crews safe and well-informed in the ever-changing marine environment.

Working with Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program member Onyx Data, Elcome deployed Microsoft Fabric —including the Real-Time Intelligence, real-time hub, and data activator features—along with Copilot to build Welcome, an industry-first, ISP-grade monitoring and management platform that is scalable, flexible, and future-proof.

“We’ve been able to reduce the latency on the data we act on from minutes to seconds, all without increasing the number of people involved in providing support to our customers,” says Jimmy Grewal, Managing Director of Elcome.
